stages.name: upstream inventory
acceptance_criteria: Inventory all executable payload modules for each of the three pinned commits with file SHA-256, selected workflow overlays and callable capability classification.
Record allowed, deferred or excluded disposition for every discovered capability; no unclassified executable module.

stages.name: license and dependency audit
acceptance_criteria: Record owner permission and redistribution scope for every migrated module and transitive dependency, with exact version/hash and notice obligations.
Block any enabled module with unresolved permission or undeclared dependency; negative gate tests pass.

stages.name: capability overlap map
acceptance_criteria: Map each upstream callable capability to an existing MR service or a justified missing function, with one implementation owner.
Document all deferred/excluded capabilities and test that no duplicate evidence store or updater authority is introduced.

stages.name: read-only trust boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Test allowlisted byte-only entry points against traversal, symlinks, hostile sizes, corrupt evidence, cancellation, timeouts and revoked authority.
Demonstrate no evidence/device writes or arbitrary commands and fail-closed acceptance after case/session/grant/source changes.

stages.name: workbench adapter
acceptance_criteria: Verify intact, modified and missing manifest payloads by SHA-256 using protected case evidence; reject duplicate/unsafe paths and bound all input/output.
Preserve per-file provenance, deterministic reports, signed acceptance and restart isolation; review disposition of all remaining Workbench functions.

stages.name: browser artifact adapter
acceptance_criteria: Review original History, Downloads, Sessions, profile and timestamp parsers; migrate only licensed and bounded functions.
Test coherent protected SQLite main/WAL/SHM families, corruption, truncation, size limits, raw timestamps, timeline provenance, cancellation and revocation without modifying original profiles.

stages.name: disk image adapter
acceptance_criteria: Review original NTFS/exFAT/FAT32/deleted metadata/extents/image verification/carving; migrate a strictly read-only capability allowlist.
Use known-answer and malformed images to verify bounds, partial versus complete recovery labels, cancellation and authority checks; prove destructive APIs unreachable.

stages.name: case provenance integration
acceptance_criteria: Every supported finding binds case/evidence IDs, original/working hashes, parser/version, pinned repository, parameters, raw reference, confidence/warnings and signed audit receipt.
Pass findings/timeline/report integrity, case isolation, revocation, cancellation, crash reconciliation and duplicate-restart acceptance tests for every enabled adapter/mode.

stages.name: CI and Windows packaging verification
acceptance_criteria: For the exact implementation tree pass required native/Linux/MSVC-WX/sanitizer/malformed/security/audit groups and AR/EN Qt at DPI 100/125/150.
Verify actual Windows Portable and Installer executable bytes, manifests, launch/install/uninstall and source provenance; retain original failure logs and scope all exclusions.
